title: The customer who could not reach you

scenes.say: The customer who could not reach you already called someone else.
scenes.visual: a phone ringing on an empty counter in a closed shop

scenes.say: They did not leave because of your price.
scenes.visual: a hand hanging up a phone, close up
a missed call notification light blinking on a phone in a dark room

scenes.say: Being easy to reach is part of the product.
scenes.visual: a shop owner smiling while talking on the phone behind a counter

scenes.say: Answer fast. Follow up the same day.
scenes.visual: a man writing a note on a pad next to a phone on a desk

scenes.say: Speed is the cheapest way to stand out.
scenes.visual: a busy small shop with customers at the counter, warm light

scenes.say: Follow for more. Build every day.
scenes.visual: an open sign glowing in a shop window at dusk

caption: They did not leave over price. They left because nobody answered.
